Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a well-defined mass in the left lower zone that is not clearly visualized on the lateral projection, indicating an extrapleural location characteristic of extralobar pulmonary sequestration. Extralobar sequestrations typically have well-defined margins and systemic (extrathoracic) venous drainage, distinguishing them from intralobar types which are intrapulmonary with ill-defined margins.
